title: CLAUDE.md
text: design splits responsibility one line (design §28): Consequences shape implementation decisions: Base R C API , via .Call. Rcpp, cpp11, runtime R package dependencies. Native symbols get registered src/init.c dynamic symbol lookup disabled; R/zucsv-package.R already carries @useDynLib zucsv, .registration = TRUE tag. Thin R wrapper. read_csv() R/read_csv.R normalizes arguments calls one C routine. validation affects native safety must also enforced C, R. Two passes file (design §9): pass 1 counts rows, fixes column count, applies na matching, infers types; pass 2 allocates column exact final length writes converted cells straight . growable vectors, intermediate row lists. v0.1 accepts seekable local file paths. zsv vendored, parser subset , src/vendor/zsv/, pinned recorded upstream commit. Never build system zsv. Keep upstream sources unmodified — R-specific adaptation belongs zucsv’s src/ files. Record repo/tag/commit/date upstream license vendoring. Strict errors, never silent NA. failed forced conversion, ragged row, embedded NUL error carrying row, column, column-name context. Raw zsv status codes stay internal. Long jumps hazard. Every FILE *, zsv_parser, native allocation must released R errors well success (R_UnwindProtect() equivalent discipline), row loop calls R_CheckUserInterrupt() periodically (≈ every 16k rows), per row. Exported names unprefixed (zucsv::read_csv(), zu_read_csv()) — package name namespace.

what: Stage 1 — Vendor zsv and prove it compiles everywhere
title: zucsv — Roadmap to v0.1.0 on CRAN
text: Goal: parser subset builds inside package CRAN’s compiler flags Linux, macOS, Windows, audit §17 complete recorded. Work Pick upstream commit. Record repo/tag/commit/date src/vendor/zsv/UPSTREAM; copy upstream LICENSE. Identify minimal parser subset (headers + sources pull API needs; nothing CLI, SQL, JSON, utf8proc-dependent). Write tools/update-zsv.sh re-copies subset given commit applies tools/patches/*.patch. src/Makevars / src/Makevars.win: explicit OBJECTS, PKG_CPPFLAGS include paths, optimisation/arch/diagnostic flags, GNU make (§19). Audit subset (§17): grep exit, abort, assert, printf, stderr, rand; compile -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Wstrict-prototypes GCC Clang C23 standard. Fix minimal patches, documented UPSTREAM reason; report genuine fixes upstream. Confirm write behaviors §10/§13/§15 depend : pull API present, empty line yields, whether BOM stripped, happens oversize row (status code whether parsing can continue), unbalanced-quote recovery. Turn fixture Stage 2. inst/COPYRIGHTS LICENSE.note. Temporary smoke entry point C_zsv_smoke(file) returning c(records, cells) — internal, exported, removed Stage 2 — prove parser runs R platforms. Exit criteria Compiles warning-free flags CI entries; R CMD check ---cran clean. UPSTREAM lists commit every patch; inst/COPYRIGHTS present. Behavior questions answered writing (short “Verified upstream behavior” section appended UPSTREAM design doc).

what: Stage 2 — End-to-end reader, character columns only
title: zucsv — Roadmap to v0.1.0 on CRAN
text: Goal: read_csv() works real files every structural feature design, returning -character data frames. Types come next; getting structure, errors, resource handling right first keeps Stage 3 purely convert.c. Work src/zucsv.h: reader struct, constants (column cap, record-size cap, interrupt interval, message truncation length), pass state. C_read_csv() entry, argument re-validation C; reader struct + R_UnwindProtect() body/cleanup (§16); scratch via R_alloc(); open file, configure parser (delimiter, column cap, record-size cap), BOM handling; pass 1: header, width, record numbering, blank-record skipping, NUL rejection, na matching, UTF-8 validation, row count, limits (§9, §10, §13, §15); pass 2: allocate STRSXP columns, fill mkCharLenCE(..., CE_UTF8) / NA_STRING, drift check pass 1; data-frame assembly: names, compact row names, class (§5); error formatting truncation (§20); R_CheckUserInterrupt() every N records passes. src/convert.c: na table construction matching, UTF-8 validator (type grammars come Stage 3). R/read_csv.R: exported wrapper, argument checks R-level messages, path.expand(), roxygen skeleton. col_types accepted "character" honored; NULL temporarily means character. Tests (tests/testthat/test-structure.R, test-errors.R, test-encoding.R): every structural item §21 — quoting, newlines, CRLF/LF, trailing delimiter, blank records positions, whitespace-records, header/-header, duplicate/empty names, BOM, UTF-8 cells/names/paths ~, invalid UTF-8, NUL, width mismatch messages, empty header-files, invalid delimiters, column cap one beyond, long cells, na variants na = NULL. Fixtures via writeBin(tempfile()). Upstream-behavior fixtures Stage 1 (test-upstream.R). Differential test utils::read.csv(colClasses = "character", ...). Manual check: interrupt multi-GB read; confirm leaked handles (e.g. lsof macOS/Linux) R session healthy afterwards. Exit criteria tests pass CI; R CMD check ---cran clean. Every error message §20 concerns structure produced verbatim test. Interrupt/cleanup manually verified procedure noted tests/README.md comment.

what: Stage 3 — Type inference and forced conversion
title: zucsv — Roadmap to v0.1.0 on CRAN
text: Goal: convert.c complete; col_types = NULL infers, explicit col_types forces, per §11–§12. Work Grammar checks {ptr, len}: logical (four exact strings), integer ([+-]?[0-9]+), double (decimal/scientific, .5, 5., Inf/-Inf/+Inf/NaN). Integer accumulation 64-bit range check [-2147483647, 2147483647]; --range promotes (inference) errors (forced). Double conversion via scratch buffer + R_strtod(). Per-column inference state (can_logical, can_integer, can_double, all_missing) final selection order; -missing → character. Pass 1 validates forced types fully; pass 2 converts LGLSXP/INTSXP/REALSXP must never fail content. Conversion error message row, column, name, truncated value (§12, §20); col_types length mismatch message. Tests (test-types.R, test-col-types.R): every type item §21 — rejected logical spellings, leading zeros, + sign, -2147483648, overflow promotion, Inf/NaN rejected spellings, " 42", -missing columns, forced types length 1 ncol, unknown names, failure message. Randomized round-trip test: generate data frames four types plus NAs, write.csv(), read_csv(), identical(); fixed seed. Differential test utils::read.csv() values canonical numeric fixtures. Exit criteria tests pass; check clean. Inference rules §11 pinned least one fixture, including rejected spellings. expect_identical() round-trip holds generated data frames.

what: Stage 4 — Hardening: memory safety, static analysis, benchmarks
title: zucsv — Roadmap to v0.1.0 on CRAN
text: Goal: native code demonstrably clean tools CRAN run acceptance, two-pass design shown pathologically slow. Work .github/workflows/native-checks.yaml, calling reusable workflows pedrobtz/r-actions@v1: sanitizers (ASan/UBSan R-devel, leak detection macOS ), valgrind, lto, gctorture rchk. Fix everything report, vendored code (patches). replace hand-rolled sanitizer job planned R-hub runs; rchk informational design, read artifact rather trusting green tick. Stress tests behind ZUCSV_STRESS=true: millions rows, 65,536 columns, multi-MB single cell, file record-size cap, repeated failing parses loop. skip_on_cran(): testthat::test_local() sets NOT_CRAN, run gctorture job, GC every 20 allocations makes cost hours prove nothing protection. Confirm “file changed reading” drift check truncating file passes test uses small file Sys.sleep-free trick (e.g. fixture whose second open redirected); proves impractical, cover code review leave comment. bench/ (.Rbuildignore): scripts comparing utils::read.csv(), readr::read_csv(), data.table::fread(), zucsv::read_csv() numeric-heavy, character-heavy, narrow, wide files (§22). Record results bench/RESULTS.md. bar “avoidable overhead”, “fastest”. Review PROTECT discipline hand rchk clean; reading read_csv.c top bottom rchk’s rules mind catches patterns rchk can miss. Exit criteria native-checks green, part required checks. rchk’s artifact read every finding either fixed explained. bench/RESULTS.md exists shows zucsv within small factor read.csv() every shape (faster expected; slower shape needs explanation file).

what: The legacy file is not UTF-8, and that matters
title: Reading Japan Post's KEN_ALL, legacy and modern
text: KEN_ALL.CSV Shift-JIS, header, uses CRLF. Ask zucsv read get error rather data frame: zucsv supposed . Row 1, column 4 first field file containing byte valid UTF-8 — half-width katakana ﾎｯｶｲﾄﾞｳ, byte offset 26. message names record column, know wrong . worth comparing, alternatives obviously worse look closely. Column 7 first record prefecture name, 北海道. Read correctly nine bytes UTF-8. fread vroom hand back raw Shift-JIS bytes encoding mark, nothing failed yet — failure arrives later, somewhere else, whatever code first tries treat bytes text. utils::read.csv() error, takes 100× longer , message points byte sequence rather location. also error print safely: message contains invalid bytes.
code: library(zucsv) read_csv(sjis, header = FALSE) #> Error in `read_csv()`: #> ! CSV contains invalid UTF-8 at row 1, column 4 ("V4") first_bytes <- function(x) paste(utils::head(charToRaw(x), 6), collapse = " ")  # data.table and vroom both accept the file and return something dt <- data.table::fread(sjis, header = FALSE, showProgress = FALSE) vr <- vroom::vroom(sjis, delim = ",", col_names = FALSE,                    show_col_types = FALSE, altrep = FALSE)  c(fread = first_bytes(dt[[7]][1]),   vroom = first_bytes(vr[[7]][1]),   truth = first_bytes(     utils::read.csv(sjis, header = FALSE, fileEncoding = "CP932")[1, 7])) #>               fread               vroom               truth  #> "96 6b 8a 43 93 b9" "96 6b 8a 43 93 b9" "e5 8c 97 e6 b5 b7"

title: Reading CSV files with zucsv
text: R short CSV readers. zucsv trying replace data.table readr; smaller thing different priorities: Semantics can check. Numeric conversion bit-identical .numeric(), construction rather coincidence. Errors problem . Invalid UTF-8, embedded NUL ragged row error naming record column, value fails later somewhere else. silent repair. title: Reading CSV files with zucsv
text: deliberate, kind thing worth knowing meet 200-megabyte file. Blank lines skipped, everywhere. Leading, trailing middle — rows. line whitespace delimiters blank: record empty cells, must match table’s width. one-column file, write intentional empty cell "" — bare empty line skipped. Nothing trimmed. " 42" text, space . Leading zeros integers. matches utils::type.convert(), postal codes zip codes lose leading zero every reader. Use col_types column identifier rather number. Column names kept exactly, duplicates empty strings included. name repair.
code: blanks <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv") writeLines(c("a,b", "1,2", "", "3,4", ""), blanks) nrow(read_csv(blanks)) #> [1] 2 padded <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv") writeLines(c("a", " 42", "1"), padded) read_csv(padded)$a #> [1] " 42" "1" codes <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv") writeLines(c("zip", "0600000", "1000001"), codes) read_csv(codes)$zip #> [1]  600000 1000001 read_csv(codes, col_types = "character")$zip #> [1] "0600000" "1000001" dupes <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv") writeLines(c("a,a,", "1,2,3"), dupes) names(read_csv(dupes)) #> [1] "a" "a" ""
